explanation: This slide serves as a visual layout showing the classification of the four DNA bases. Thymine (T) and Cytosine (C) are grouped under Pyrimidines. Adenine (A) and Guanine (G) are grouped under Purines.

questions.q: Under which category do Cytosine and Thymine fall?
questions.exp: Option B is correct because the slide classifies Thymine (T) and Cytosine (C) as Pyrimidines. Adenine and Guanine are Purines (Option A).
